about_the_game: Welcome to the Tiny Racing Demo! In this sample track, navigate tight turns and drift through a vibrant, retro-style racetrack. Master the art of controlled skids and perfect your racing lines to beat the computer cars. Time to burn rubber!
detailed_description: Welcome to the Tiny Racing Demo! In this sample track, navigate tight turns and drift through a vibrant, retro-style racetrack. Master the art of controlled skids and perfect your racing lines to beat the computer cars. Time to burn rubber!
name: Tiny Racing Demo

short_description: Tiny Racing revs up the retro racing experience! Tear through this pixel art demo circuit, mastering hairpin turns with sick drifts. Tiny Racing delivers a nostalgic and fresh racing adventure that keeps you on the edge of your seat!
